### The same creator launching their own pump.fun coin instead

On pump.fun the creator fee is paid on all of the coin's volume, whichever frontend or terminal routes it; terminal share does not reduce it.

| creator fee schedule (on-chain) | bps |
|---|---|
| bonding curve, flat | 30 |
| PumpSwap, market cap < 420 SOL | 30 |
| PumpSwap, 420–1,470 SOL | 95 |
| PumpSwap, 9,820–14,740 SOL | 70 |
| PumpSwap, 49,120–54,030 SOL | 30 |
| PumpSwap, ≥ 98,240 SOL | 5 |
| figure given in the brief | 5 (0.05%) |

| own coin | lifetime volume (assumed) | creator fees at the on-chain schedule | at 0.05% (brief) |
|---|---|---|---|
| doesn't run (dies on the curve) | $2.0k | $6 | $1 |
| doesn't run (dies on the curve) | $10.0k | $30 | $5 |
| doesn't run (dies on the curve) | $30.0k | $90 | $15 |
| runs, peak mcap $1.00M | $1.00M | $8.7k (PumpSwap blended 89 bps) | $500 |
| runs, peak mcap $10.00M | $10.00M | $73.8k (PumpSwap blended 74 bps) | $5.0k |
| runs, peak mcap $50.00M | $50.00M | $289.5k (PumpSwap blended 58 bps) | $25.0k |

'Blended' spreads PumpSwap volume evenly in log market cap from 420 SOL to the peak and applies the tier in force; the first $30k is assumed to trade on the curve. These volume paths are illustrations, not measurements.
